tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open tech jobs at companies hiring in Vietnam, refreshed hourly by techjobs.vn. Use when the user looks for jobs by role, skill, seniority, city or company. Returns the best matches, newest first, each with a techjobs.vn link to share with the user.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Short summary, key skills and techjobs.vn link of one open job, by its id from search_jobs or its techjobs.vn link. Use when the user wants to know more about a specific job. Share the link so the user can read the full description and apply.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find companies tracked by techjobs.vn by name, with their number of open jobs and referrers. Use to look up a company's slug, then get_company for its profile or search_jobs for its jobs.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Profile of a company hiring in Vietnam: introduction, industry, size, tech stack, number of open jobs on techjobs.vn, whether employees there refer candidates and, for a few companies, a positive TechJobs estimate from public sources (not an official ranking; no label means not enough public data, n

tools.name: search_programs
tools.description: Find internship, fresher, graduate, management-trainee and scholarship programs for students and new graduates in Vietnam, in tech and other fields: whether applications are open, the deadline and the career field. Open programs come first, soonest deadline first. Use when a student asks about inter

tools.name: search_remote_jobs
tools.description: Remote roles at foreign companies (techjobs.vn /remote), by default only those someone living in Vietnam can take. For companies hiring in Vietnam use search_jobs.

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: Details of one internship, fresher, graduate or scholarship program in Vietnam: overview, who can apply, benefits, selection process, locations, deadlines of each cycle and the official application link. Use after search_programs when the user wants to know more about a program.

tools.name: list_my_cvs
tools.description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Lists the signed-in user's CVs on techjobs.vn: the primary CV (used for job matching and referral requests) and their other CVs, each with a link to open it. Use it to pick a cv_id; read a CV's content with get_cv and rate it with score_cv.

tools.name: score_cv
tools.description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Gives the basic score (0–100, fixed rules, no AI) of the signed-in user's primary CV, or of one of their other CVs by cv_id, with the score per criterion and short suggestions to fix, plus a link to edit the CV on techjobs.vn.

tools.description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Reads the sections of the user's primary CV (or of another of their CVs by cv_id): language, name, contact details, headline, summary, experience, projects, achievements, skills, education, certifications, languages, in the shape update_cv_variant takes. Returns the copy's content and a link for the user to review it. The primary CV

Open requests show the job, CV summary (with years of exper

tools.name: request_cv_changes

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_company_referrers, request_referral, list_referrer_registrations, list_referrer_requests · Private data: get_cv, set_primary_cv, delete_cv_variant, save_interview_retro, list_referrer_requests, confirm_referral_contact · Public sink: search_jobs, get_job, update_cv_variant, register_as_referrer, list_referrer_registrations, set_referrer_email_notifications, update_referrer_profile, list_referrer_requests, mark_referral_request_referred, decline_referral_request, request_cv_changes · Destructive: delete_cv_variant, list_interviews, log_interview.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_company_referrers, request_referral, list_referrer_registrations, list_referrer_requests · Private data: get_cv, set_primary_cv, delete_cv_variant, save_interview_retro, list_referrer_requests, confirm_referral_contact · Public sink: search_jobs, get_job, update_cv_variant, register_as_referrer, list_referrer_registrations, set_referrer_email_notifications, update_referrer_profile, list_referrer_requests, mark_referral_request_referred, decline_referral_request, request_cv_changes · Destructive: delete_cv_variant, list_interviews, log_interview

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
